title: Christmas Toilet Paper Mini Bundle
author: selinab157
description:
Christmas Toilet Paper Mini Bundle
This is an instant download cutting file compatible with many different cutting software/machines like Cricut Silhouette.
Possible uses include: scrap, T-shirts, posters, greeting cards, banners, mugs, totes, invitations, scrapbooking, vinyl decals, paper crafting, decorations, art prints, and so much more!
You will receive a ZIP folder with the following:
– 20 SVG files (vector)
– 20 DXF files
– 20 PNG files (300 dpi high resolution and transparent background)
– 20 EPS files (vector)
– 20 PDF files
All designs in this shop are instant download products. No physical product will be shipped to you.
Get this great bundle for just $3 and save $57!
